summary.en: Archduke Franz Ferdinand, heir to Austria-Hungary's throne, and his wife Sophie are shot dead in Sarajevo by Gavrilo Princip, a Bosnian Serb student.
summary.zh: 奥匈帝国皇储弗朗茨·斐迪南大公和妻子索菲在萨拉热窝被波斯尼亚塞族学生加夫里洛·普林西普开枪打死。

detail.en: Princip was one of seven young conspirators of the Young Bosnia movement posted along the archduke's route (one account counts six armed men). They had received weapons and help from the Black Hand, a secret society led by Colonel Dragutin Dimitrijević ('Apis'), head of Serbian military intelligence. A bomb thrown earlier that morning missed; Princip fired after the archduke's car took a wrong turn near the Latin Bridge. Princip, a month short of 20, was too young for the death penalty; he was sentenced to 20 years and died of tuberculosis in prison in April 1918.
detail.zh: 普林西普是“青年波斯尼亚”运动的七名青年密谋者之一，他们分布在大公车队经过的路线上（另一说持武器的是六人）。他们的武器和帮助来自“黑手会”——由塞尔维亚军事情报首脑德拉古廷·迪米特里耶维奇上校（外号“阿皮斯”）领导的秘密组织。当天上午早些时候有人投掷炸弹，没有击中；后来大公的汽车在拉丁桥附近拐错了路，普林西普开了枪。他离 20 岁还差一个月，按法律不能判死刑，被判 20 年徒刑，1918 年 4 月死于狱中结核病。

summary.en: At Potsdam and Berlin on 5–6 July, Germany assures Austria-Hungary of its full support in whatever action it takes against Serbia.
summary.zh: 7 月 5–6 日，德国在波茨坦和柏林向奥匈帝国保证：无论它对塞尔维亚采取什么行动，德国都全力支持。

detail.en: Chancellor Bethmann Hollweg's telegram of 6 July told Vienna that the Kaiser would 'faithfully stand by Austria-Hungary'. Historians call this promise the 'blank cheque' because it left the decision, and its risks, to Austria-Hungary.
detail.zh: 首相贝特曼·霍尔韦格 7 月 6 日的电报告诉维也纳：德皇将“忠实地站在奥匈帝国一边”。历史学家把这一承诺称为“空白支票”，因为它把决定和风险都交给了奥匈帝国。

summary.en: Austria-Hungary's envoy in Belgrade hands Serbia a note with ten demands and 48 hours to answer.
summary.zh: 奥匈帝国驻贝尔格莱德公使向塞尔维亚递交照会，提出十条要求，限 48 小时答复。

detail.en: The note demanded that Serbia suppress anti-Austrian propaganda and organisations, dismiss named officers and let Austro-Hungarian officials take part in the investigation of the plot on Serbian soil. Serbia's reply, delivered on 25 July just before the 6 p.m. deadline, accepted most points but refused point 6 as a breach of its constitution. Austria-Hungary broke off relations the same evening.
detail.zh: 照会要求塞尔维亚取缔反奥宣传和组织、撤换点名的军官，并允许奥匈官员到塞尔维亚境内参与调查刺杀阴谋。塞尔维亚在 7 月 25 日下午 6 时期限前递交答复，接受了大部分条件，但以违反宪法为由拒绝第 6 条。奥匈帝国当晚即与塞尔维亚断交。

title.zh: 奥匈帝国对塞尔维亚宣战

summary.en: Austria-Hungary declares war on Serbia; early on 29 July its Danube monitors shell Belgrade.
summary.zh: 奥匈帝国对塞尔维亚宣战；7 月 29 日凌晨，它的多瑙河浅水重炮舰炮击贝尔格莱德。

detail.en: The declaration was sent by telegram from Vienna. At 2.20 a.m. on 29 July the river monitors Temes, Bodrog and Számos opened fire on Belgrade across the Sava and Danube. Russia ordered partial mobilisation on 29 July and general mobilisation on 30 July.
detail.zh: 宣战书从维也纳以电报发出。7 月 29 日凌晨 2 时 20 分，浅水重炮舰“泰梅什号”“博德罗格号”“萨莫什号”隔着萨瓦河和多瑙河向贝尔格莱德开炮。俄国 7 月 29 日宣布局部动员，30 日宣布总动员。

summary.en: Tsar Nicholas II signs the order for general mobilisation, after a day of partial mobilisation against Austria-Hungary only.
summary.zh: 沙皇尼古拉二世签署总动员令；此前一天，俄国只针对奥匈帝国实行了局部动员。

summary.en: Germany mobilises and declares war on Russia; on 3 August it declares war on France.
summary.zh: 德国宣布总动员并对俄国宣战；8 月 3 日又对法国宣战。

summary.en: After Germany invades neutral Belgium, Britain declares war on Germany; its dominions, India and colonies, Singapore and Malaya among them, are at war with it.
summary.zh: 德国入侵中立的比利时之后，英国对德宣战；英国的自治领、印度和各殖民地——包括新加坡和马来亚——随之进入战争状态。

detail.en: Britain, France, Prussia, Austria and Russia had guaranteed Belgium's neutrality in the Treaty of London (1839). The declaration on 4 August covered the whole British Empire; the dominions' governments decided only how much to contribute.
detail.zh: 英国、法国、普鲁士、奥地利和俄国在 1839 年的《伦敦条约》中保证比利时中立。8 月 4 日的宣战适用于整个大英帝国；各自治领政府能决定的只是出多少力。

summary.en: German troops attack the ring of twelve forts around Liège; the last forts fall on 16 August, about nine days later than planned.
summary.zh: 德军进攻列日周围由 12 座要塞组成的防御圈；最后几座要塞 8 月 16 日才陷落，比计划晚了约九天。

detail.en: The siege took eleven days instead of the two the German plan allowed. Heavy German and Austro-Hungarian siege howitzers finally destroyed the forts. Around Liège nearly 850 civilians were killed by the invading army between 5 and 8 August alone.
detail.zh: 这场围攻用了 11 天，而德国计划只留了两天。最后是德国和奥匈的重型攻城榴弹炮摧毁了要塞。仅 8 月 5 日至 8 日，列日周围就有近 850 名平民被入侵军队杀害。

summary.en: German troops kill about 200 inhabitants of Andenne on the Meuse, shot in the streets and in their homes.
summary.zh: 德军在默兹河畔的昂代讷杀害约 200 名居民，有的在街上被枪杀，有的死在家中。

detail.en: A local count gives 199 people shot or killed in their homes and 18 missing, 217 victims in all, and 43 more in Seilles across the river.
detail.zh: 当地的统计是：199 人被枪杀或死在家中，18 人失踪，共 217 名遇难者；河对岸的塞耶另有 43 人。

summary.en: French offensives in Lorraine and the Ardennes are thrown back; on 22 August alone more than 27,000 French soldiers are killed.
summary.zh: 法军在洛林和阿登地区的攻势被击退；仅 8 月 22 日一天，法军阵亡就超过 27,000 人。

detail.en: Under Plan XVII the French attacked into Lorraine from 14 August and into the Belgian Ardennes from 21 August, in red trousers and dark-blue coats, against German machine guns and artillery. The marker stands at Rossignol in the Ardennes, where a French colonial division was destroyed on 22 August. Between 20 and 27 August the French army lost 40,000 men. Britannica gives Allied losses in the whole battle as more than 200,000 of about 1.5 million engaged.
detail.zh: 按照第十七号计划，法军 8 月 14 日起攻入洛林，21 日起攻入比利时阿登地区，士兵穿着红裤子和深蓝色上衣，迎着德军的机枪和火炮前进。图上标记在阿登的罗西尼奥尔，8 月 22 日一个法国殖民地师在那里几乎全军覆没。8 月 20 日至 27 日，法军损失 4 万人。《不列颠百科全书》估计整个边境之战中，协约国参战约 150 万人，损失 20 万以上。

summary.en: German troops kill 383 civilians at Tamines on the Sambre, 269 of them in one mass execution beside the church.
summary.zh: 德军在桑布尔河畔的塔明杀害 383 名平民，其中 269 人在教堂旁的一次集体枪决中被杀。

detail.en: Tamines lay on the line of the German Second Army's advance across the Sambre. The troops said they had been fired on by civilians; Horne and Kramer found no evidence of civilian resistance there or elsewhere.
detail.zh: 塔明位于德军第 2 集团军渡过桑布尔河的进军路线上。德军声称遭到平民射击；霍恩和克雷默的研究在这里和其他地方都没有找到平民抵抗的证据。

summary.en: Saxon troops of the German Third Army kill 674 civilians in Dinant, one in ten of the town's people, from infants to the elderly.
summary.zh: 德军第 3 集团军的萨克森部队在迪南杀害 674 名平民，占全城人口的十分之一，从婴儿到老人都有。

detail.en: The killings took place on 23 August as the Germans fought to cross the Meuse against French troops on the west bank. In the largest single execution 137 people were shot. Much of the town was burned. The German army justified the killings by claiming that civilians had fired on its soldiers; post-war research found that the shots came from French soldiers and from German troops' own confusion.
detail.zh: 屠杀发生在 8 月 23 日，当时德军正与默兹河西岸的法军交战、强渡默兹河。规模最大的一次集体处决中，137 人被枪杀。城区大半被焚毁。德军以平民向士兵开枪为由为杀戮辩护；战后研究认为，枪声来自法军和德军自己的混乱。

summary.en: The British Expeditionary Force holds the canal line at Mons for a day against Kluck's First Army, then begins a long retreat.
summary.zh: 英国远征军在蒙斯运河一线抵挡克卢克的德军第 1 集团军一整天，随后开始长距离撤退。

detail.en: About 70,000 British professional soldiers met about 160,000 Germans. Losses on 23–24 August were about 4,200 British and 4,900 German (other counts give about 1,600 British for 23 August alone). At Le Cateau on 26 August the British lost 7,812 men in a rearguard battle.
detail.zh: 约 7 万名英国职业军人对阵约 16 万德军。8 月 23–24 日，英军损失约 4,200 人，德军约 4,900 人（另一统计仅 23 日英军伤亡约 1,600 人）。8 月 26 日在勒卡托的后卫战中，英军又损失 7,812 人。

summary.en: German troops kill 248 civilians in the university town of Leuven and burn the university library with about 300,000 books and 1,000 manuscripts.
summary.zh: 德军在大学城鲁汶杀害 248 名平民，并焚毁大学图书馆，约 30 万册图书和 1,000 份手稿化为灰烬。

detail.en: On the evening of 25 August panicked shooting among German troops in the town was blamed on civilians. Over the next days soldiers shot residents, burned houses across the town and set fire to the library. The destruction of the library became known around the world; it was rebuilt after the war with international help.
detail.zh: 8 月 25 日晚，城里德军之间因惊慌而相互开枪，却被归咎于平民。此后几天，士兵枪杀居民，焚烧全城各处的房屋，并纵火焚烧图书馆。图书馆被毁的消息传遍世界；战后在各国帮助下重建。

summary.en: French and British armies counter-attack east of Paris; about 2 million men fight, and on 9 September the German armies begin to retreat to the Aisne.
summary.zh: 法军和英军在巴黎以东反击；约 200 万人投入战斗，9 月 9 日德军开始向埃纳河撤退。

detail.en: The French Sixth Army struck the flank of Kluck's First Army on the Ourcq; Kluck turned to face it, opening a gap between his army and Bülow's Second Army. The British and the French Fifth Army advanced into the gap, and the Germans withdrew. Some French reinforcements were carried from Paris in about 600 taxis, though most troops travelled by train. About 500,000 soldiers of both sides were killed or wounded.
detail.zh: 法军第 6 集团军在乌尔克河打击克卢克第 1 集团军的侧翼；克卢克转身迎战，与比洛的第 2 集团军之间拉开了缺口。英军和法军第 5 集团军乘隙推进，德军被迫后撤。约 600 辆巴黎出租车运送了一部分法军援兵，但多数部队是坐火车赶到的。双方共有约 50 万士兵死伤。

summary.en: German attacks fail to break through around Ypres; Germany loses about 130,000 men and the Entente about 100,000, among them soldiers of the Indian Corps.
summary.zh: 德军在伊普尔周围的进攻没能突破；德军损失约 13 万人，协约国约 10 万人，其中有印度军团的士兵。

detail.en: The battle ended the 'race to the sea'. Britannica gives more than 54,000 British, at least 50,000 French, more than 20,000 Belgian and more than 130,000 German casualties in the fighting from La Bassée to the Yser. Near Langemarck on 10 November more than 10,000 German soldiers, many of them young volunteers, were killed or wounded; German propaganda later turned this into a myth of student regiments.
detail.zh: 这场战役结束了“奔向大海”。《不列颠百科全书》统计，从拉巴塞到伊瑟河的战斗中，英军伤亡 5.4 万余人，法军至少 5 万，比利时军 2 万以上，德军 13 万以上。11 月 10 日在朗厄马克附近，1 万多名德军士兵死伤，其中不少是年轻志愿兵；德国宣传后来把这件事渲染成“学生军团”的神话。

summary.en: The Serbian army defeats the invading Austro-Hungarian forces on Cer mountain and drives them back across the Drina: the Entente's first victory of the war.
summary.zh: 塞尔维亚军队在采尔山击败入侵的奥匈军队，把他们赶回德里纳河对岸，这是协约国一方在这场战争中的第一次胜利。

detail.en: Dates differ: Tasić gives the decisive fighting on Cer as 17–19 August; Britannica gives 15–20 August, with further fighting at Šabac until 24 August.
detail.zh: 日期说法不一：塔西奇把采尔山的决定性战斗定在 8 月 17–19 日；《不列颠百科全书》作 8 月 15–20 日，沙巴茨一带的战斗持续到 24 日。

summary.en: During their first invasion of Serbia, Austro-Hungarian troops kill or cause the disappearance of up to 4,000 civilians in the Mačva region; at Šabac some 80 people are shot in a churchyard.
summary.zh: 奥匈军队第一次入侵塞尔维亚期间，在马奇瓦地区杀害或致使失踪的平民多达 4,000 人；在沙巴茨，约 80 人在教堂墓地被枪杀。

detail.en: The Swiss criminologist R. A. Reiss, who investigated for the Serbian government, counted about 3,500 to 4,000 civilian victims of the first invasion, not including Šabac; at Lešnica 109 people were killed. Austro-Hungarian commanders treated the Serbian population as hostile and ordered hostages taken and suspects shot. At Šabac on 17 August about 80 people were ordered to be shot; the killings there cost some 200 lives.
detail.zh: 受塞尔维亚政府委托调查的瑞士犯罪学家 R. A. 赖斯统计，第一次入侵造成约 3,500 到 4,000 名平民遇难，不含沙巴茨；莱什尼察有 109 人被杀。奥匈指挥官把塞尔维亚居民视为敌对人群，下令扣押人质、枪决嫌疑人。8 月 17 日在沙巴茨，约 80 人被下令枪决；那里的杀戮共夺去约 200 人的生命。

summary.en: The Russian First Army defeats the German Eighth Army at Gumbinnen in East Prussia; the Germans lose over 14,000 men here and at Stallupönen.
summary.zh: 俄军第 1 集团军在东普鲁士的贡宾嫩击败德军第 8 集团军；德军在这里和施塔卢普嫩共伤亡 1.4 万余人。

summary.en: The German Eighth Army surrounds Samsonov's Russian Second Army; 92,000 to 95,000 Russians are captured and Samsonov shoots himself.
summary.zh: 德军第 8 集团军包围萨姆索诺夫的俄军第 2 集团军；9.2 万到 9.5 万名俄军被俘，萨姆索诺夫开枪自杀。

detail.en: After Gumbinnen the Eighth Army, now led by Paul von Hindenburg and Erich Ludendorff, moved most of its strength by rail against the Second Army while the Russian First Army stayed passive. Russian losses are given as 30,000 killed or wounded and about 92,000 prisoners (Britannica), or about 120,000 to 125,000 in all, including 95,000 prisoners (Nagornaja, Dowling). German losses were about 10,000 to 15,000. Samsonov shot himself on 29 or 30 August. The Germans named the battle after Tannenberg, where the Teutonic Knights had been defeated in 1410.
detail.zh: 贡宾嫩之后，由保罗·冯·兴登堡和埃里希·鲁登道夫指挥的第 8 集团军把大部分兵力用铁路调去对付俄军第 2 集团军，而俄军第 1 集团军按兵不动。俄军损失一说为死伤 3 万、被俘约 9.2 万（《不列颠百科全书》），一说共约 12 万到 12.5 万，其中被俘 9.5 万（纳戈尔纳娅、道林）。德军损失约 1 万到 1.5 万。萨姆索诺夫于 8 月 29 日或 30 日自杀。德国人用坦嫩贝格为这场战役命名，因为 1410 年条顿骑士团曾在那里战败。

title.en: First Battle of the Masurian Lakes

summary.en: The German Eighth Army turns on the Russian First Army and drives it out of East Prussia; the Russians lose some 100,000 men.
summary.zh: 德军第 8 集团军转而攻击俄军第 1 集团军，把它赶出东普鲁士；俄军损失约 10 万人。

detail.en: Rennenkampf's army inflicted nearly 70,000 casualties but suffered some 100,000 of its own. During their invasions of East Prussia Russian troops deliberately killed 1,491 German civilians in executions and individual murders.
detail.zh: 伦宁坎普的部队使德军伤亡近 7 万人，自身损失约 10 万人。俄军入侵东普鲁士期间，通过处决和个别杀害，蓄意杀死德国平民 1,491 人。

summary.en: Russian armies defeat Austria-Hungary in Galicia and take Lemberg (Lviv) on 3 September; Austria-Hungary loses about 300,000 to 360,000 men.
summary.zh: 俄军在加利西亚击败奥匈军队，9 月 3 日攻占伦贝格（今利沃夫）；奥匈损失约 30 万到 36 万人。

detail.en: The Battle of Galicia was a series of battles from late August to mid-September. The Russian Presidential Library gives Russian losses of 230,000 and Austro-Hungarian losses of about 360,000, including about 120,000 prisoners; Dowling gives over 300,000 Austro-Hungarian losses, nearly a third of the force. The Austro-Hungarian armies retreated towards the Carpathians, leaving the fortress of Przemyśl to be besieged.
detail.zh: 加利西亚战役是 8 月下旬到 9 月中旬的一连串战斗。俄罗斯总统图书馆给出的数字是俄军损失 23 万，奥匈约 36 万，其中被俘约 12 万；道林的数字是奥匈损失 30 万以上，接近其兵力的三分之一。奥匈军队向喀尔巴阡山方向撤退，普热梅希尔要塞随后被围。

summary.en: Russian troops besiege the Austro-Hungarian fortress of Przemyśl and its garrison of about 130,000; it holds out until 22 March 1915.
summary.zh: 俄军围攻奥匈帝国的普热梅希尔要塞，守军约 13 万人；要塞一直坚守到 1915 年 3 月 22 日。

title.en: Ottoman raid on Russia's Black Sea ports
title.zh: 奥斯曼舰队袭击俄国黑海港口

summary.en: Ottoman warships, among them the former German cruisers Goeben and Breslau, shell Sevastopol, Odessa and Novorossiysk; the Ottoman Empire enters the war.
summary.zh: 奥斯曼军舰——其中包括原属德国的巡洋舰“戈本号”和“布雷斯劳号”——炮击塞瓦斯托波尔、敖德萨和新罗西斯克，奥斯曼帝国由此参战。

detail.en: Russia declared war on 2 November (1 November in some accounts), and Britain and France on 5 November. On 14 November the Ottoman religious authority declared a jihad against the Entente powers.
detail.zh: 俄国 11 月 2 日宣战（一说 11 月 1 日），英国和法国 11 月 5 日宣战。11 月 14 日，奥斯曼宗教最高机构宣布对协约国进行圣战。

summary.en: British-Indian troops land at Fao at the head of the Persian Gulf on 6 November and take Basra later in the month.
summary.zh: 英印军 11 月 6 日在波斯湾顶端的法奥登陆，当月晚些时候攻占巴士拉。

detail.en: The force came from the Indian Army and was sent to protect the Anglo-Persian oil installations at Abadan. Sources date the capture of Basra between 20 and 23 November.
detail.zh: 这支部队来自英属印度陆军，任务是保护阿巴丹的英波石油设施。各来源对攻占巴士拉的日期记载在 11 月 20 日到 23 日之间。

summary.en: After a second Austro-Hungarian invasion pushes deep into Serbia, a Serbian counter-offensive from 3 December drives it out; Belgrade is retaken on 15 December.
summary.zh: 奥匈第二次入侵深入塞尔维亚之后，塞军从 12 月 3 日起反攻，把奥匈军队赶出国境，12 月 15 日收复贝尔格莱德。

detail.en: In the whole 1914 campaign Austria-Hungary lost about 275,000 men in Serbia: 28,276 killed, 122,122 wounded, 76,644 missing, 2,046 captured and 46,716 sick. Serbian losses were about 163,500 killed, wounded, captured and missing.
detail.zh: 1914 年整个战役中，奥匈在塞尔维亚损失约 27.5 万人：阵亡 28,276、负伤 122,122、失踪 76,644、被俘 2,046、患病 46,716。塞军死伤、被俘和失踪约 16.35 万人。

summary.en: Enver Pasha's winter offensive against the Russians in the Caucasus fails; the Ottoman Third Army loses between 60,000 and 90,000 men, many of them frozen to death.
summary.zh: 恩维尔帕夏在高加索对俄军发动冬季攻势，以失败告终；奥斯曼第 3 集团军损失 6 万到 9 万人，许多人冻死。

detail.en: Enver took direct command and sent two corps on a flanking march through mountains in deep snow. Estimates of Ottoman strength run from about 75,000 to over 118,000. Losses: about 60,000 by the Turkish official history (including 20,000 dead of frostbite and disease), 70,000 by a Russian staff officer (up to 30,000 frozen), 90,000 by a French officer. Russian losses were around 20,000, about 6,000 from frostbite.
detail.zh: 恩维尔亲自指挥，派两个军在深雪中翻山迂回。对奥斯曼兵力的估计从约 7.5 万到 11.8 万以上。损失：土耳其官方战史约 6 万（其中冻伤和疾病致死 2 万），一位俄国参谋军官估计 7 万（冻死多达 3 万），一位法国军官估计 9 万。俄军损失约 2 万，其中约 6,000 人因冻伤。

summary.en: After Germany ignores its ultimatum to hand over the Jiaozhou Bay territory, Japan, Britain's ally, declares war on Germany.
summary.zh: 德国没有理会日本要求交出胶州湾租借地的最后通牒，英国的盟国日本随即对德宣战。

summary.en: British forces from the Gold Coast and French forces from Dahomey take the German colony of Togoland in the first month of the war.
summary.zh: 来自黄金海岸的英军和来自达荷美的法军在战争第一个月攻占德属多哥。

summary.en: German Samoa falls without bloodshed to a New Zealand force supported by Australian, British and French warships.
summary.zh: 德属萨摩亚兵不血刃地落入新西兰部队之手，澳大利亚、英国和法国军舰提供支援。

summary.en: Japanese troops land at Longkou in neutral China, north of Tsingtao, and move inland along the Shandong railway.
summary.zh: 日军在青岛以北、中立的中国境内的龙口登陆，沿山东铁路向内地推进。

detail.en: China protested that the landing and the seizure of the Qingdao–Jinan railway broke its neutrality; it declared the area around Longkou, Laizhou and Jiaozhou a war zone so as not to be held responsible. A second Japanese landing followed on 18 September, eighteen miles from Tsingtao.
detail.zh: 中国抗议日军登陆和夺取胶济铁路违反中国的中立，并把龙口、莱州和胶州一带划为战区，以免承担责任。9 月 18 日，日军又在离青岛 18 英里处第二次登陆。

summary.en: Australian naval reservists land on New Britain and take the German radio station at Bita Paka; six Australians are killed or die of wounds.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚海军预备役人员在新不列颠岛登陆，攻占比塔帕卡的德国无线电台；6 名澳大利亚人阵亡或伤重不治。

detail.en: The Australian Naval and Military Expeditionary Force, an infantry battalion of 1,000 and 500 naval reservists, raised the British flag at Rabaul on 13 September; within a few weeks the whole of German New Guinea surrendered.
detail.zh: 澳大利亚海陆军远征部队由 1,000 人的步兵营和 500 名海军预备役人员组成，9 月 13 日在拉包尔升起英国国旗；数周之内，德属新几内亚全境投降。

summary.en: Japanese and British forces besiege the German naval base at Tsingtao (Qingdao); the garrison surrenders on 7 November.
summary.zh: 日英联军围攻德国在青岛的海军基地；守军于 11 月 7 日投降。

detail.en: About 20,000 Japanese troops with more than 140 guns (nearly 50,000 ground troops in all, by another count) and 1,500 British soldiers faced a garrison of about 4,000 to 5,000. Japanese aircraft attacked from 4 September. The British lost 12 killed and 53 wounded. More than 4,600 German and Austro-Hungarian prisoners were held in camps in Japan until after the war.
detail.zh: 约 2 万名日军携 140 多门火炮（另一说全部陆军近 5 万人）和 1,500 名英军，对阵约 4,000 到 5,000 名守军。日本飞机从 9 月 4 日起参加攻击。英军阵亡 12 人、负伤 53 人。4,600 多名德国和奥匈战俘被关押在日本的战俘营里，直到战后。

title.zh: 埃姆登号炮击马德拉斯

summary.en: The German cruiser Emden shells Madras at night and sets the Burmah Oil Company's tanks on fire.
summary.zh: 德国巡洋舰埃姆登号夜袭马德拉斯，炮击缅甸石油公司的油罐，引起大火。

title.zh: 日本占领德属密克罗尼西亚

summary.en: Japanese naval squadrons occupy the Marshall Islands and the Caroline Islands, including Truk, Germany's possessions in the north Pacific.
summary.zh: 日本海军舰队占领德国在北太平洋的属地马绍尔群岛和加罗林群岛，包括特鲁克。

summary.en: The Emden enters Penang harbour at dawn, sinks the Russian cruiser Zhemchug at anchor and then the French destroyer Mousquet.
summary.zh: 埃姆登号黎明时驶入槟城港，击沉停泊中的俄国巡洋舰珍珠号，随后又击沉法国驱逐舰火枪号。

detail.en: Over half of the Mousquet's crew died. In all the Emden captured or sank 25 Allied merchant ships and two warships before she was destroyed at the Cocos Islands on 9 November.
detail.zh: 火枪号半数以上船员遇难。在 11 月 9 日于科科斯群岛被击毁之前，埃姆登号共俘获或击沉协约国商船 25 艘、军舰 2 艘。

title.en: Sydney and Emden at the Cocos Islands
title.zh: 悉尼号与埃姆登号在科科斯群岛

summary.en: The Australian cruiser HMAS Sydney catches the Emden at North Keeling in the Cocos Islands and drives her ashore, a wreck.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚巡洋舰悉尼号在科科斯群岛的北基林岛截住埃姆登号，将其重创搁浅。

detail.en: About 130 of the Emden's crew were killed and 69 wounded; the Sydney lost four killed and 16 wounded. The Royal Australian Navy gives 134 German dead.
detail.zh: 埃姆登号约 130 人阵亡、69 人负伤；悉尼号 4 人阵亡、16 人负伤。澳大利亚皇家海军作德方死亡 134 人。

summary.en: Japan's minister in Beijing hands President Yuan Shikai twenty-one demands in five groups, starting with Germany's rights in Shandong.
summary.zh: 日本驻华公使向袁世凯总统面交分为五号的二十一条要求，第一号就是继承德国在山东的权益。

detail.en: After a Japanese ultimatum on 7 May, Yuan accepted all but the fifth group, which would have put Japanese advisers into China's government and police; the treaties were signed on 25 May 1915.
detail.zh: 5 月 7 日日本发出最后通牒后，袁世凯接受了除第五号以外的各条——第五号要求中国政府和警察聘用日本顾问；条约于 1915 年 5 月 25 日签订。

summary.en: About half of the Indian 5th Light Infantry mutinies at Alexandra Barracks; British, Japanese, French and Russian sailors, volunteers and the Sultan of Johor's men put it down.
summary.zh: 印度第 5 轻步兵团约一半士兵在亚历山德拉兵营哗变；英国、日本、法国和俄国水兵、志愿军以及柔佛苏丹的部队将其镇压。

detail.en: The mutineers killed 44 British officers, soldiers and civilians and five Chinese and Malay civilians; 56 of them were killed. Courts martial convicted 202 men; 41 to 47 were executed, most of them shot in public outside Outram Prison, and 63 to 64 were transported for life. About 124 people died in all.
detail.zh: 哗变士兵杀死 44 名英国军官、士兵和平民，以及 5 名华人和马来平民；哗变士兵中 56 人被打死。军事法庭判处 202 人有罪，41 到 47 人被处决，大多在欧南监狱外公开枪决，63 到 64 人被终身流放。前后共约 124 人死亡。

title.en: Arrests in Constantinople: the Armenian genocide begins
title.zh: 君士坦丁堡大逮捕：亚美尼亚种族灭绝开始

summary.en: The Ottoman government arrests hundreds of Armenian writers, doctors, lawyers and community leaders in Constantinople; most are later killed. Deportations and massacres across Anatolia follow.
summary.zh: 奥斯曼政府在君士坦丁堡逮捕数百名亚美尼亚作家、医生、律师和社区领袖，其中大多数后来被杀害。随后，驱逐和屠杀遍及安纳托利亚。

detail.en: A deportation law followed on 27 May 1915. Men were usually killed near their towns; women, children and the old were marched south to the Syrian desert. Scholars estimate 664,000 to 1.5 million Armenian deaths. The Turkish state puts the losses at about 300,000, attributes them to wartime relocation, revenge attacks, famine and epidemics, and rejects the term genocide.
detail.zh: 1915 年 5 月 27 日颁布驱逐法令。男子通常在家乡附近被杀害；妇女、儿童和老人被押往南方的叙利亚沙漠。学者估计亚美尼亚人死亡 66.4 万到 150 万。土耳其国家认为损失约 30 万，把死亡归因于战时迁移、报复性袭击、饥荒和疫病，不接受种族灭绝的定性。

summary.en: Australian and New Zealand troops land at Anzac Cove and British, French and Indian troops at Cape Helles to open the Dardanelles; the Ottoman Fifth Army holds the heights.
summary.zh: 澳新军团在澳新湾、英法印军队在赫勒斯角登陆，想打通达达尼尔海峡；奥斯曼第 5 集团军守住了高地。

detail.en: The campaign lasted until January 1916. About 48,700 (Australian War Memorial) to 58,000 (Gallipoli Association) Entente soldiers and about 87,000 Ottoman soldiers died; casualties of all kinds may have reached half a million.
detail.zh: 战役一直持续到 1916 年 1 月。协约国一方约 4.87 万（澳大利亚战争纪念馆）到 5.8 万人（加里波利协会）、奥斯曼一方约 8.7 万人死亡；各类伤亡合计可能多达 50 万。

summary.en: German and Austro-Hungarian armies break through the Russian front in Galicia; the Russian 'Great Retreat' follows.
summary.zh: 德奥军队在加利西亚突破俄军防线，俄军随即开始“大撤退”。

detail.en: German troops entered Warsaw on 5 August. By the end of August all of Poland was occupied and 750,000 Russians had been taken prisoner in four months; Russia lost over 1.4 million soldiers in the retreat.
detail.zh: 8 月 5 日德军进入华沙。到 8 月底，波兰全境被占领，四个月里 75 万俄军被俘；俄军在大撤退中共损失 140 多万人。

title.en: Russian army expels Jews from Kovno and Kurland
title.zh: 俄军驱逐科夫诺和库尔兰的犹太人

summary.en: Accusing them of disloyalty, the retreating Russian army expels about 200,000 Jews from the provinces of Kovno and Kurland, often with only hours to leave.
summary.zh: 撤退中的俄军指控犹太人不忠，把约 20 万犹太人逐出科夫诺省和库尔兰省，常常只给几个小时收拾离开。

summary.en: Promised territory by the secret Treaty of London of 26 April, Italy declares war on Austria-Hungary.
summary.zh: 根据 4 月 26 日的秘密《伦敦条约》获得领土许诺后，意大利对奥匈宣战。

title.en: First four battles of the Isonzo

summary.en: Italian offensives across the Isonzo river gain almost nothing; the four battles of 1915 cost Italy about 280,000 men.
summary.zh: 意军四次强攻伊松佐河一线，几乎毫无进展；1915 年的四次战役使意大利损失约 28 万人。

summary.en: After a campaign by about 60,000 South African troops, the German forces surrender at Khorab.
summary.zh: 约 6 万名南非军队经过一场战役后，德军在霍拉布投降。

summary.en: Armenian deportees are driven to camps along the Euphrates and around Deir ez-Zor in the Syrian desert; in the second half of 1916 most of those still alive there are massacred.
summary.zh: 被驱逐的亚美尼亚人被赶到幼发拉底河沿岸和叙利亚沙漠代尔祖尔一带的营地；1916 年下半年，那里幸存的人大多遭到屠杀。

detail.en: From July to December 1916, about 192,750 deportees concentrated at Deir ez-Zor were killed, by the Ottoman authorities' own count, mostly by bands of the Special Organization. Earlier, in March 1916, some 40,000 internees were killed at Ras ul-Ayn.
detail.zh: 1916 年 7 月至 12 月，集中在代尔祖尔的约 192,750 名被驱逐者被杀害（据奥斯曼当局自己的统计），主要由“特别组织”的武装团伙执行。此前，1916 年 3 月，约 4 万名被拘押者在拉斯艾因被杀害。

summary.en: German and Austro-Hungarian armies cross the Danube; from 11 October Bulgaria attacks from the east. Serbia is overrun.
summary.zh: 德奥军队渡过多瑙河；10 月 11 日起保加利亚从东面进攻。塞尔维亚被占领。

detail.en: On 25 November the Serbian High Command ordered the retreat through Montenegro and Albania. Thousands of soldiers died in the snow-covered mountains; the National Army Museum gives over 200,000 Serbian soldiers dead in the retreat. Some 169,828 soldiers and civilians were carried by Allied ships to Corfu, Bizerte, Italy and France.
detail.zh: 11 月 25 日，塞尔维亚最高统帅部下令经黑山和阿尔巴尼亚撤退。数以千计的士兵死在积雪的山里；英国国家陆军博物馆给出的撤退中塞军死亡人数为 20 万以上。约 169,828 名士兵和平民被协约国船只运到科孚岛、比塞大、意大利和法国。

summary.en: Bulgaria, which signed a treaty with the Central Powers on 6 September, attacks Serbia, promised Serbian territory in return.
summary.zh: 9 月 6 日与同盟国签约的保加利亚进攻塞尔维亚，换取塞尔维亚领土的许诺。

summary.en: Ottoman forces besiege about 10,000 British and Indian troops at Kut on the Tigris; after relief attempts fail, the garrison surrenders on 29 April 1916.
summary.zh: 奥斯曼军队在底格里斯河畔的库特围困约 1 万名英印军队；解围失败后，守军于 1916 年 4 月 29 日投降。

detail.en: Relief attempts cost about 23,000 casualties. About 13,000 men went into captivity, and a third of them died from disease, malnutrition and ill-treatment.
detail.zh: 几次解围共伤亡约 2.3 万人。约 1.3 万人被俘，其中三分之一死于疾病、营养不良和虐待。

summary.en: Entente troops leave Anzac and Suvla on 19–20 December and Cape Helles on 9 January 1916.
summary.zh: 协约国军队 12 月 19 日至 20 日撤离澳新湾和苏夫拉，1916 年 1 月 9 日撤离赫勒斯角。

summary.en: The last German stronghold in Kamerun, the mountain fort of Mora, surrenders, completing the Allied conquest of the colony.
summary.zh: 喀麦隆最后的德军据点——山地要塞莫拉——投降，协约国完成对这块殖民地的占领。

summary.en: Germany attacks the French fortress city of Verdun; after ten months the front is back almost where it began.
summary.zh: 德军进攻法国要塞城市凡尔登；十个月后，战线几乎回到了起点。

detail.en: Fort Douaumont fell on 25 February and was retaken on 24 October; Fort Vaux was retaken on 3 November. About 163,000 French and 143,000 German soldiers were killed or went missing, and 216,000 French and 190,000 German soldiers were wounded. Two-thirds to three-quarters of the French army served at Verdun in turn.
detail.zh: 杜奥蒙堡 2 月 25 日失守，10 月 24 日被夺回；沃堡 11 月 3 日被夺回。法军约 16.3 万、德军约 14.3 万人阵亡或失踪，法军 21.6 万、德军 19 万人负伤。法军的三分之二到四分之三先后轮换到过凡尔登。

summary.en: Irish republicans seize the General Post Office and other buildings in Dublin and proclaim an Irish Republic; they surrender after six days of fighting.
summary.zh: 爱尔兰共和派占领都柏林邮政总局等建筑，宣布成立爱尔兰共和国；六天战斗后投降。

detail.en: 485 people died, 54 per cent of them civilians, including 40 children. Fourteen leaders were shot at Kilmainham Gaol between 3 and 12 May, Thomas Kent in Cork on 9 May, and Roger Casement was hanged in London on 3 August.
detail.zh: 共有 485 人死亡，其中平民占 54%，包括 40 名儿童。5 月 3 日至 12 日，14 名领导人在基尔梅纳姆监狱被枪决；托马斯·肯特 5 月 9 日在科克被处决；罗杰·凯斯门特 8 月 3 日在伦敦被绞死。

summary.en: An Austro-Hungarian offensive from the Trentino breaks into the Asiago plateau before it is halted; about 230,000 men are lost on both sides.
summary.zh: 奥匈军队从特伦蒂诺发动攻势，攻入阿夏戈高原后被挡住；双方共损失约 23 万人。

summary.en: Britain and France, with Russia's assent, secretly agree how to divide the Ottoman Empire's Arab provinces into zones of control and influence.
summary.zh: 英法两国在俄国同意下，秘密商定把奥斯曼帝国的阿拉伯省份划分为控制区和势力范围。

summary.en: Russian armies under Aleksei Brusilov attack along the whole south-western front, take Lutsk on 7 June and Czernowitz on 18 June, and break the Austro-Hungarian line.
summary.zh: 布鲁西洛夫指挥的俄军在整个西南战线发起进攻，6 月 7 日攻占卢茨克，6 月 18 日攻占切尔诺夫策，突破奥匈防线。

detail.en: Austro-Hungarian losses are estimated at about 1 million (Deutsches Historisches Museum) to 1.5 million including about 400,000 prisoners; Russian losses at about 1 million to 1.5 million.
detail.zh: 奥匈的损失估计约 100 万（德国历史博物馆）到 150 万，其中被俘约 40 万；俄军的损失约 100 万到 150 万。

summary.en: Sharif Hussein bin Ali of Mecca proclaims a revolt against Ottoman rule; his forces attack the Ottoman garrison of Mecca.
summary.zh: 麦加的谢里夫侯赛因·本·阿里宣布起兵反抗奥斯曼统治，他的部队进攻麦加的奥斯曼守军。

summary.en: British and French armies attack on the Somme; on the first day the British Army loses 57,470 men, 19,240 of them killed.
summary.zh: 英法军队在索姆河发起进攻；第一天英军就损失 57,470 人，其中阵亡 19,240 人。

detail.en: A week-long bombardment of about 1.5 million shells failed to destroy the German wire and dugouts. By 18 November the British had advanced about 8 km and the French about 12 km. German losses are disputed: 437,322 (Denizot) or at least 450,000 (National Army Museum), with higher estimates.
detail.zh: 持续一周、约 150 万发炮弹的炮击，没能摧毁德军的铁丝网和掩蔽部。到 11 月 18 日，英军推进约 8 公里，法军约 12 公里。德军损失有争议：437,322 人（德尼佐）或至少 45 万（英国国家陆军博物馆），也有更高的估计。

title.en: Central Asian revolt and its repression

summary.en: A tsarist decree to conscript Central Asian men for labour behind the front sets off a revolt; Russian troops and settlers crush it, and at least 150,000 Kazakhs and Kyrgyz die.
summary.zh: 沙皇下令征召中亚男子到前线后方服劳役，引发起义；俄军和移民将其镇压，至少 15 万哈萨克人和吉尔吉斯人死亡。

detail.en: The decree of 25 June 1916 (Old Style) was to take some 220,000 men aged 19 to 43. Estimates of the dead run from at least 150,000 to more than 250,000; hundreds of thousands of survivors fled across the mountains into Chinese Turkestan. Kyrgyz remember it as the Urkun, the exodus.
detail.zh: 1916 年 6 月 25 日（俄历）的法令要征召约 22 万名 19 至 43 岁的男子。死亡人数估计从至少 15 万到 25 万以上；数十万幸存者翻山逃入中国新疆。吉尔吉斯人称之为“大逃亡”（Urkun）。

title.en: Sixth Battle of the Isonzo: Gorizia
title.zh: 第六次伊松佐河战役：戈里齐亚

summary.en: Italian troops cross the Isonzo and take Gorizia on 8–9 August.
summary.zh: 意军渡过伊松佐河，8 月 8 日至 9 日攻占戈里齐亚。

summary.en: Romania declares war on Austria-Hungary and invades Transylvania.
summary.zh: 罗马尼亚对奥匈宣战，出兵特兰西瓦尼亚。

summary.en: Bulgarian and German troops take the Romanian Danube fortress of Tutrakan; some 28,000 Romanian soldiers are captured.
summary.zh: 保加利亚和德国军队攻占罗马尼亚在多瑙河畔的图特拉坎要塞，约 2.8 万名罗马尼亚士兵被俘。

title.zh: 弗莱尔—库尔瑟莱特：第一批坦克

summary.en: British tanks go into battle for the first time on the Somme; of 49 earmarked, 32 reach the start line and 18 go into action.
summary.zh: 英国坦克第一次在索姆河投入战斗：原定 49 辆，32 辆到达出发线，18 辆投入战斗。

title.zh: 比利时工人被强行押往德国

summary.en: The German army begins deporting Belgian men to Germany for forced labour; about 60,000 are taken in three months.
summary.zh: 德军开始把比利时男子押往德国强迫劳动；三个月里约有 6 万人被押走。

detail.en: About 120,000 Belgians were deported between 1916 and 1918; 2,614 died in deportation.
detail.zh: 1916–1918 年，约 12 万比利时人被强行押走，2,614 人死在押送途中或劳动地。

summary.en: German, Austro-Hungarian, Bulgarian and Ottoman forces under August von Mackensen enter Bucharest; most of Romania is occupied.
summary.zh: 马肯森指挥的德国、奥匈、保加利亚和奥斯曼军队进入布加勒斯特，罗马尼亚大部被占领。

detail.en: Of 500,000 Romanian soldiers mobilised in 1916, about 160,000 were killed and 140,000 captured by the end of the campaign.
detail.zh: 1916 年动员的 50 万罗马尼亚士兵中，到战役结束时约 16 万人阵亡、14 万人被俘。

title.en: North Sea declared a military area
title.zh: 北海被宣布为军事区域

summary.en: Britain declares the whole North Sea a military area; ships bound for Germany and neutral ports are stopped and searched, and food is treated as contraband.
summary.zh: 英国宣布整个北海为军事区域；开往德国和中立港口的船只被拦截搜查，粮食被当作禁运品。

summary.en: The German submarine U-20 torpedoes the British liner Lusitania off the Old Head of Kinsale; she sinks in under 20 minutes and 1,198 of the 1,959 people aboard die.
summary.zh: 德国潜艇 U-20 在老金塞尔角外用鱼雷击中英国邮轮卢西塔尼亚号；不到 20 分钟船就沉没，船上 1,959 人中有 1,198 人遇难。

detail.en: 128 of the dead were citizens of the neutral United States. Germany said the ship carried military supplies; there was a quantity of ammunition on board.
detail.zh: 遇难者中有 128 名中立国美国的公民。德国说这艘船运载军用物资；船上确实有一批弹药。

summary.en: The British Grand Fleet and the German High Seas Fleet, about 250 ships in all, fight the war's only full-scale fleet battle off Jutland.
summary.zh: 英国大舰队与德国公海舰队共约 250 艘舰船在日德兰外海交战，这是一战中唯一一次全面的舰队决战。

detail.en: Britain lost 14 ships and Germany 11. The German fleet returned to port and the British blockade continued. The battleship HMS Malaya, funded by the governments of the Federated Malay States, fought in the battle.
detail.zh: 英国损失 14 艘舰船，德国 11 艘。德国舰队返回港口，英国的封锁继续进行。马来联邦政府出资建造的战列舰马来亚号参加了这场海战。

summary.en: After a poor potato harvest and under the Allied blockade, German cities live on swede turnips; daily rations fall below 1,000 calories.
summary.zh: 土豆歉收，又遭协约国封锁，德国城市靠芜菁度日；每天的配给热量不足 1,000 卡。

detail.en: A German government study of December 1918 blamed the blockade for 762,796 civilian deaths; historians today estimate 478,500 to 800,000 deaths from hunger-related disease and also point to Germany's own food policy and hoarding.
detail.zh: 德国政府 1918 年 12 月的研究把 762,796 名平民的死亡归咎于封锁；今天的历史学者估计，死于与饥饿有关的疾病的有 47.85 万到 80 万人，并指出德国自身的粮食政策和囤积也有责任。

summary.en: Germany declares that from 1 February its U-boats will sink ships in the waters around Britain without warning.
summary.zh: 德国宣布，自 2 月 1 日起，其 U 艇将在英国周围海域不加警告地击沉船只。

summary.en: The beach where Australian and New Zealand troops landed on 25 April 1915; today part of the Gallipoli peninsula's war cemeteries and memorials.
summary.zh: 1915 年 4 月 25 日澳新军团登陆的海滩；今天是加里波利半岛战争墓地和纪念地的一部分。

title.zh: 埃里温齐采尔纳卡别尔德纪念碑

summary.en: The Armenian Genocide memorial in Yerevan, opened in 1967; every year on 24 April thousands of people come here.
summary.zh: 位于埃里温的亚美尼亚种族灭绝纪念碑，1967 年落成；每年 4 月 24 日都有成千上万的人来到这里。

summary.en: Inaugurated in 1932, the ossuary holds the remains of about 130,000 unidentified soldiers of both sides who fell at Verdun.
summary.zh: 1932 年落成的藏骨堂，安放着在凡尔登阵亡、无法辨认身份的双方士兵约 13 万人的遗骨。

summary.en: The memorial to the missing of the Somme bears the names of more than 72,000 British and South African soldiers who have no known grave.
summary.zh: 索姆河失踪者纪念碑，刻着 7.2 万多名没有坟墓的英国和南非士兵的名字。

summary.en: The British Chinese Labour Corps had its base and hospital at Noyelles-sur-Mer; its cemetery at Nolette holds the graves of Chinese labourers who died in France.
summary.zh: 英方华工团的大本营和医院设在努瓦耶勒；诺莱特的墓地里安葬着死在法国的华工。
